text: {faith:hunt}管比较、差异与拆解，帝国不祭祀祂，民间猎人信祂。信力看的是打完一场战斗，按点的类型给：普通、精英、猎手、核心一级比一级多；每局头一回把一种猎获品置入背包也给，越稀有给得越多。献祭爱血肉、骨制品、皮革，猎获品的倍率最高。

texts.en: {faith:hunt} governs comparison, difference and dissection. The Empire does not worship this god, but common hunters do. Faith points come from finishing battles, scaled by the spot's type: normal, elite, hunter and Core each give more than the last. The first time in a run that you place a kind of quarry into your pack also gives Faith points, more for rarer kinds. This god favors Offerings of flesh, bone items and leather, with quarry earning the highest multipliers.
